{"code": "
import re
seq=''.join(l.strip() for l in open('region.fasta') if not l.startswith('>'))
comp=str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA')
rc=seq.translate(comp)[::-1]
code={
'TTT':'F','TTC':'F','TTA':'L','TTG':'L','CTT':'L','CTC':'L','CTA':'L','CTG':'L',
'ATT':'I','ATC':'I','ATA':'I','ATG':'M','GTT':'V','GTC':'V','GTA':'V','GTG':'V',
'TCT':'S','TCC':'S','TCA':'S','TCG':'S','CCT':'P','CCC':'P','CCA':'P','CCG':'P',
'ACT':'T','ACC':'T','ACA':'T','ACG':'T','GCT':'A','GCC':'A','GCA':'A','GCG':'A',
'TAT':'Y','TAC':'Y','TAA':'*','TAG':'*','CAT':'H','CAC':'H','CAA':'Q','CAG':'Q',
'AAT':'N','AAC':'N','AAA':'K','AAG':'K','GAT':'D','GAC':'D','GAA':'E','GAG':'E',
'TGT':'C','TGC':'C','TGA':'*','TGG':'W','CGT':'R','CGC':'R','CGA':'R','CGG':'R',
'AGT':'S','AGC':'S','AGA':'R','AGG':'R','GGT':'G','GGC':'G','GGA':'G','GGG':'G'}
def orflen(s,i):
    n=0
    while i+3<=len(s):
        c=code[s[i:i+3]]
        if c=='*': return n
        n+=1; i+=3
    return n
print("rev strand starts (ATG):")
for m in re.finditer('ATG', rc):
    i=m.start()
    L=orflen(rc,i)
    if L>=30:
        print('  rev pos',i,'codons',L,'fwd',3000-i)
print("fwd strand starts (ATG):")
for m in re.finditer('ATG', seq):
    i=m.start()
    L=orflen(seq,i)
    if L>=30:
        print('  fwd pos',i,'codons',L)
print()
print("slippery-like motifs on rc strand (X XXY YYZ):")
# heptamer: positions1-3 all same base and 4-6 all same base (e.g. AAA AAA, GGG GGG), plus known A AAA AAG style
for m in re.finditer(r'(?=([ACGT])\1\1([ACGT])\2\2[ACGT])', rc):
    print('  rc',m.start(), m.group(1))
"}

seq=''.join(l.strip() for l in open('region.fasta') if not l.startswith('>'))
comp=str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA')
rc=seq.translate(comp)[::-1]
def gc(s):

print("GC whole region:",round(gc(seq),3))
for name,st in [('fwd',seq),('rev',rc)]:

{"code": "
import re
seq=''.join(l.strip() for l in open('region.fasta') if not l.startswith('>'))
comp=str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA')
rc=seq.translate(comp)[::-1]
stops={'TAA','TAG','TGA'}
def openlen(s,i,limit=500):
    n=0
    while i+3<=len(s) and n<limit:
        if s[i:i+3] in stops: return n
        n+=1;i+=3
    return n
for nm,s in [('fwd',seq),('rev',rc)]:
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?=([ACGT])\1\1([ACGT])\2\2[ACGT])', s):
        p=m.start()
        print(nm,'slippery at',p, s[p:p+10],
              'open(+0 from p+6):',openlen(s,p+6),
              'open(-1 from p+2):',openlen(s,p+2),
              'open(+1 from p+7):',openlen(s,p+7),
              'stop_in_frame0_within:', min([k for k in range(0,20) if s[p+6+3*k:p+9+3*k] in stops]+[99]))
"}

seq=''.join(l.strip() for l in open('region.fasta') if not l.startswith('>'))

code={

'ATT':'I','ATC':'I','ATA':'I','ATG':'M','GTT':'V','GTC':'V','GTA':'V','GTG':'V',
'TCT':'S','TCC':'S','TCA':'S','TCG':'S','CCT':'P','CCC':'P','CCA':'P','CCG':'P',

'AAT':'N','AAC':'N','AAA':'K','AAG':'K','GAT':'D','GAC':'D','GAA':'E','GAG':'E',
'TGT':'C','TGC':'C','TGA':'*','TGG':'W','CGT':'R','CGC':'R','CGA':'R','CGG':'R',
'AGT':'S','AGC':'S','AGA':'R','AGG':'R','GGT':'G','GGC':'G','GGA':'G','GGG':'G'}
def cu(a,b):
    s=rc[a:b]
    return collections.Counter(s[i:i+3] for i in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
ref=cu(65,1514)+cu(1824,2706)+cu(2715,3000)
tot=sum(ref.values())

test=cu(1341,1626)

# log-odds under reference codon usage (excluding stops)
import math
llo=0
for k,v in test.items():

print('log-odds of 95codon ORF codons under reference usage vs uniform:',round(llo,2))
# same for a comparably sized real region: GeneC 95 codons
for nm,(a,b) in [('GeneC',(2715,3000)),('GeneB_part',(1824,2109))]:

    l=sum(v*math.log((ref[k]/tot)/(1/61)) for k,v in tt.items())

import collections, math
seq=''.join(l.strip() for l in open('region.fasta') if not l.startswith('>'))
comp=str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA')

stops={'TAA','TAG','TGA'}

    return collections.Counter(s[i:i+3] for i in range(a,b-2,3))
ref=cu(rc,65,1514)+cu(rc,1824,2706)+cu(rc,2715,3000)
tot=sum(ref.values())
allc=[a+b+c for a in 'ACGT' for b in 'ACGT' for c in 'ACGT' if a+b+c not in stops]
P={k:(ref[k]+max(1,0.02*tot))/(tot+len(allc)*max(1,0.02*tot)) for k in allc}

import collections, math
seq=''.join(l.strip() for l in open('region.fasta') if not l.startswith('>'))
comp=str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA')
rc=seq.translate(comp)[::-1]
stops={'TAA','TAG','TGA'}
def cu(s,a,b):
    return collections.Counter(s[i:i+3] for i in range(a,b-2,3))
ref=cu(rc,65,1514)+cu(rc,1824,2706)+cu(rc,2715,3000)
for k in stops: ref.pop(k,None)
tot=sum(ref.values())
allc=[a+b+c for a in 'ACGT' for b in 'ACGT' for c in 'ACGT' if a+b+c not in stops]
pc=0.02*tot
P={k:(ref[k]+pc)/(tot+len(allc)*pc) for k in allc}
U=1/len(allc)
def score(s,a,b,label):
    t={k:v for k,v in cu(s,a,b).items() if k not in stops}
    n=sum(t.values())
    l=sum(v*math.log(P[k]/U) for k,v in t.items())
    print('%-28s codons %3d  logodds %7.1f  per-codon %6.3f'%(label,n,l,l/n))
